newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam sells furniture unit to U.S. Industries unit.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam sells furniture unit to U.S. Industries unit.

text.p: Sunbeam Corp. has agreed to sell its outdoor furniture division to Jacuzzi Outdoor Products, Inc., a unit of U.S. Industries Inc., for about $84.5 million, the companies said Tuesday.
Sunbeam, known best for its Sunbeam and Oster appliances, said it will retain accounts receivable and certain fixed assets, resulting in a value of more than $120 million at closing.
The sale is by far the largest of Sunbeam's planned divestitures announced in November to turn the Delray Beach, Fla.-based company into a major maker of household products.

Sunbeam's furniture division is the nation's leading producer of casual outdoor furniture, focusing on aluminum, wrought iron and resin patio furniture. The sale includes factories, related equipment and inventory and furniture trademarks.
The division has about 2,000 employees and had revenues of about $205 million in 1996.
U.S. Industries' brands include Jacuzzi whirlpools, Ames garden tools, Ertl toys, Rexair vacuum cleaners, EJ Footwear, Garden State Tanning and Tommy Armour Golf.
"The product offering and channels of distribution of the Sunbeam Furniture business are a good fit with Jacuzzi and Ames," said John Raos, president of U.S. Industries, based in Iselin, N.J.
"This acquisition provides us an opportunity to capitalise on our well-regarded brand names with product line extensions."
It said it expects the acquisition to boost this year's operating earnings.
The deal is expected to close within 30 days, subject to antitrust approval.
In early trading, Sunbeam's stock edged down 12.5 cents to $25.50, and U.S. Industries fell 12.5 cents to $33.50, both on the New York Stock Exchange.
